name: Terrarium 100x45x45
label: Large terrarium
lead: Glass terrarium measuring 100x45x45 cm. Volume: 202.5 liters, horizontal format. Handmade in Novi Sad.

description.html: With a floor of 100x45 cm and a height of 45 cm, this terrarium holds about 202.5 liters. That is some forty liters more than the 100x40x40 model, and the difference shows in width and height: a bearded dragon turns more easily, and the lamp can sit further from the basking spot.

An adult bearded dragon has more than the minimum 100x40 cm of floor here. The 45 cm depth suits a ball python because it fits two larger hides, one on the warm side and one on the cool side. A blue-tongued skink and tortoises use the whole floor area, so keep their decor low and along the edges.

This size is most often ordered with an added 3D background or a Lacobel back, and we have both variants as ready-made models too. You choose the outer film from 34 patterns. A terrarium one meter long arrives by courier, so prepare a cabinet at least 45 cm deep. If you need it 10 cm longer or shorter, we complete the change of dimensions in 7 to 14 days.
